ideas.title: The long domino run
ideas.critique: A physics toy plus a chase film is a nice spectacle, and the chain knocking balls, buckets and crabs is charming. But it is a rigid-body toy and a physics goal example, a place-based game in a form close to mini game, and nothing about the island itself changes.

ideas.title: Throw a pot
ideas.critique: A pottery wheel is a new, tactile mini game with glazes that show off Hikari, which is a plus. Still one more playable activity and prop of a kind the island has, with pots on a shelf as the usual permanent object.

ideas.title: King tide
ideas.critique: The sea flooding the low shore and friends fleeing uphill is the same payoff as the seesaw and its mini game, and the island-wide sea motion event has been done several times. The stranded dawn leftovers are a nice touch but small.

ideas.title: Demolition day
ideas.nearest: Me, to cut out and fold
ideas.critique: Destroying Lumi's own workshop is a bold, dramatic act with the friends' ears-flat reaction, and fracture is new to the island. But it is a physics-goal example (things that break), a one-off set piece, and the rebuild is a vague afterthought.

ideas.title: My computer
ideas.critique: A live ASCII view of the world with typed commands that act on it is a genuinely different interface: the island seen and controlled as text. It is a prop in the same family as the TV, but the two-way command loop makes it the strongest and least guessable pitch here.

ideas.title: The family tree
ideas.critique: A growing prop fed by lineage data is the slow permanent change of Paths we wore, and it visualises the breeding pen's output, so it is a data display riding on an earlier post. A pretty procedural tree, but it is one more thing placed on the island.

ideas.title: Through the mirror pond
ideas.critique: A whole second flipped island you cross into, with night and day swapped and backward speech, changes what the island is, and mirror materials suit the path tracer. Risk is that it stays a film of a look-change zone with a few reversed lines.

ideas.title: My den in the woods
ideas.nearest: Me, to cut out and fold
ideas.critique: A hidden place with Lumi's things is one more place or building of a kind the island has, and the stills show a static scene. Tying it to the real sleep and wake is a nice link to goal 5, but a player finding a den is expected.

ideas.title: Glass house
ideas.critique: Caustics through thick glass are exactly what a path tracer does and a game engine cannot, which is on goal 7. But it is another building with a sunrise film, a permanent look change, and the strange plants add only a small twist.

ideas.title: Gravity goes away for a minute
ideas.critique: An island-wide rule that lets everything float and then crash down is a vivid change in how things move, with a good payoff of everyone ending up elsewhere. It sits in the roaming world-rule and island-wide motion event form, and the physics-goal match caps it.
